title: TasteProfile
description: Learner preferences accumulated across runs. Unlike every other artifact this is NOT per-run - it lives at the artifact root and is read by topic_research as an input, then updated by the app shell after each lesson.

axes.description: Continuous preferences. 0 is neutral - a fresh profile is all zeroes and must behave exactly as if no profile existed.

pace.description: -1 slower and more repetition, +1 faster and denser.

depth.description: -1 intuitive and plain-language, +1 technical and precise.

concreteness.description: -1 abstract principle first, +1 concrete example first.

strategy_weights.description: Per-strategy bias applied when topic_research selects a pedagogy. Keys are the strategy enum from research-brief.schema.json; absent keys mean neutral.

direction_weights.description: Bias toward next_topics directions the learner keeps choosing.

notes.description: Verbatim learner feedback, newest first. Capped - an unbounded list silently becomes the whole prompt.

topics_seen.description: Topics already covered, so next_topics does not loop back onto them.

history.description: One entry per completed lesson. The evidence behind the axes above - keep it so a profile can be recomputed rather than only mutated.

reactions.description: Explicit taps. Each maps to a signed nudge on one axis; the mapping lives in the taste-profile reference doc, not here.

dropoff_seconds.description: Where the learner stopped watching. Absent means they finished.
